استعدن (form X)
# اِسْتَعَدْنَ (istaʕadna) /is.ta.ʕad.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعَادَ (istaʕāda)
# اُسْتُعِدْنَ (ustuʕidna) /us.tu.ʕid.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَعَادَ (istaʕāda)
# اِسْتَعِدْنَ (istaʕidna) /is.ta.ʕid.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعَادَ (istaʕāda)
